description: Complete union of existing positive lexical inventories, lowercased with JavaScript toLowerCase. No NFC rewrite, frequency cutoff, typo priors, evaluation examples or user documents. This conservative inventory proves lexical ambiguity only; it does not authorize corrections.
format: LCDAWG1: little-endian child-first minimal acyclic automaton; sorted symbol-ID edges; terminal/start metadata; min/max suffix lengths; Unicode scalar alphabet.
